caption:
India just more than doubled its bet on semiconductors.

On August 31, the government notified Semicon 2.0 — a ₹1.27 lakh crore scheme, versus ₹76,000 crore under the first phase in 2022. New fabs now get 40% of capital costs covered, and this round also funds chip design, packaging, and specialty materials — not just factories.

If you're in engineering, or thinking about where to build a career next — this sector just got a lot more serious.
